title: Appointing the day for the convening of the second session of the One Hundred Fourteenth Congress.
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was introduced. The summary of that version is repeated here.)

This joint resolution convenes the second session of the 114th Congress at noon on January 4, 2016.

summary.headline: A joint resolution set noon on January 4, 2016, as the time Congress would begin its second session of the 114th Congress.
summary.what_it_does: This law sets the date and time for the second session of the 114th Congress to start. It says the session convenes at noon on January 4, 2016. It is a procedural measure about scheduling Congress's own work.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The session it sets was scheduled to begin at noon on January 4, 2016.
